issues.where: rings, lower left (crops D, T, U) and right of the limb (crops I, X)
issues.what: the ring reads as loose, smeared brush streaks rather than a continuous ring. The left and right arcs do not line up into one ellipse, and they fade in and out in patches
issues.fix: render the ring as one continuous geometric ellipse with consistent radial banding, and occlude it correctly behind the globe

issues.where: right limb, lower right (crops E, I, W)
issues.what: a thin cyan rim line sits apart from the dark edge of the disc, so the limb looks doubled, like a separate halo layer laid over the globe
issues.fix: fold the rim glow into the atmosphere falloff so it blends from the limb outward with no gap or second edge

issues.where: right limb, lower right (crops I, R, W)
issues.what: the same detached cyan rim line and doubled limb edge
issues.fix: blend the rim light into a single soft atmospheric gradient

issues.where: cloud bands, mid and right of the disc (crops E, G, L)
issues.what: the cloud streaks look painterly and airbrushed, with smeared, motion-blurred strokes and little fine structure at native size
issues.fix: add higher-frequency cloud detail and sharper edges to the cirrus streaks

issues.where: interior of the dark storm (crops A, Q)
issues.what: the storm interior is filled with concentric swirl rings that look procedural and slightly pinched
issues.fix: break up the concentric swirl with irregular turbulence

issues.what: the moon's surface is soft and low in detail, with a flat pink and white tone and no crisp craters at native size
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution moon texture with stronger relief shading

issues.where: dark sky and night side (crops D, O, T)
issues.what: when brightened, the black sky shows a blotchy, smudgy noise texture instead of a clean dark field
issues.fix: clean the sky background and keep the noise fine and uniform

issues.where: lower-right dark limb where the rings cross the planet (crops A and D in image-14.png, N and O in image-15.png, S in image-16.png)
issues.what: a sharp circular silhouette edge of the planet cuts and dims the ring bands in a hard step while the rings simultaneously continue across the dark disk
issues.fix: fix planet-ring occlusion masking so the opaque globe cleanly blocks the far ring arc and the near ring arc passes cleanly in front without a semi-transparent disk cutout

issues.where: across the opaque cloud deck, especially around the vortex and dark blue cloud bands (crops A, D, F, I in image-10.png, P in image-11.png, S in image-12.png)
issues.what: sharp pinpoint white star-like dots are scattered directly on top of the planet's clouds
issues.fix: mask the starfield strictly to space outside the planetary limb and remove stray bright single-pixel specks from the cloud layer

issues.where: right-hand limb transitioning into the nightside (crops A and F in image-14.png)
issues.what: the atmospheric glow pinches into a razor-thin hard cyan line with a dark inner trough before cutting off abruptly
issues.fix: widen and soften the radial and azimuthal falloff of the atmospheric scattering along the terminator and dark limb

issues.where: ring bands at native resolution (crops A, C, D, F in image-14.png, M, O, R in image-15.png, S in image-16.png)
issues.what: the rings break into coarse, blotchy blue-grey speckles and noisy clumps rather than continuous fine ringlets
issues.fix: render continuous concentric ring density and optical-depth profiles with sub-pixel anti-aliasing instead of noisy stippled blotches

issues.where: near-field lower cloud deck and bottom corners (crops D and E in image-10.png, M, O, R in image-11.png, S, T, U, V in image-12.png)
issues.what: cloud textures become soft, blurry, and smeared compared with the sharper mid-ground storm bands
issues.fix: maintain crisp high-frequency cloud detail across the foreground and lower frame without smear or low-resolution blur

issues.where: moon on the right (crops C and G in image-14.png, K in image-15.png) and sunlit blue globe (crop B in image-14.png)
issues.what: the moon has a soft airbrushed surface with a stepped cyan-white fringe along its lit left limb, and the planet's blue cloud deck looks slightly painterly with a few stray bright specks
issues.fix: use higher-resolution surface and cloud displacement/albedo detail, anti-alias the moon's lit limb without chromatic fringing, and remove stray specks on the sunlit disk

issues.where: upper-left starfield and upper-right Milky Way band (crops C, F, I in image-10.png)
issues.what: several stars near the upper-left edge are horizontally elongated blobs and dense Milky Way clusters dissolve into soft smudged patches
issues.fix: render stars as clean anti-aliased point-spread functions free of edge coma/smear and sharpen unresolved background star clouds
